_comment: Real REA graphs of a bigger (7-module) Electron app, generated via examples/rea-docker. Stress-tests the signature diff on harder cases. Note: REA models modules/imports/IPC/endpoints/windows, NOT individual function definitions, so a function-level change (movefunc) is below its node granularity and correctly reads as no change -- the diff must not hallucinate it.

pairs.name: reorder
pairs.note: pure intra-file reorder of store.js -> ideal diff empty (the #4520 case at scale)

pairs.name: addmod
pairs.note: added src/cache.js module + its import -> detected

pairs.name: movefunc
pairs.note: removed a helper FUNCTION (rand) -> below REA's node granularity, correctly 0
